title: Nichols Plot
text: Bode plot of linear system computed from nonlinear Simulink model, 1 input, 1 output, {Linear system sample time} sets Sample time of linear system; {Show Plot} sets the open plot, {Show plot on block open} sets the open plot when opening block, {Response Optimization} sets the open Response Optimizer, {Linearization inputs/outputs} sets the portion of model to linearize linear analysis, {Enable regular expression} enables signal searching using regular, {Show filtered results as a flat list} displays filtered bus signal hierarchy using flat, {Linearize on} sets when to compute linear model Simulation, {Snapshot times} sets the simulation times at which to compute linear, {Trigger type} sets the type of external trigger to detect Rising, {Enable zero-crossing detection}, {Use exact delays}, {Sample time rate conversion method} sets the rate conversion method, {Prewarp frequency}, {Use full block names} uses full block path in state, input, and output, {Use bus signal names}, {Include upper magnitude bound in assertion} sets the check whether Bode magnitude violates upper, {Frequencies}, {Magnitudes}, {Include lower magnitude bound in assertion} sets the check whether Bode magnitude violates lower, {Save data to workspace} sets the save linear systems for further analysis, {Variable name} sets the name of data structure for saving linear systems, {Save operating points for each linearization} sets the save operating points with linearization, {Enable assertion} enables bound checking, {Simulation callback when assertion fails} sets the expression to evaluate when bounds are, {Stop simulation when assertion fails} sets the stop simulation when bounds are violated and {Output assertion signal} adds assertion output port. Values come from the instance.
